capabilities._note: audio: none. Wan 2.2 makes no sound: every take is a mute mp4, whatever the shot's audio policy (it renders `silent`, with a note in the take), and assemble lays silence under it.

models._note: Glob patterns (case-insensitive) naming the files each model parameter of the binding takes, for the model identification that reads them; `family` is its id for the file header check (high vs low noise is decided by the name: the headers are identical). `model` is the high noise (first stage) model, `model_low` the low noise one.

template._note: Wan 2.2 14B renders 4k+1 frames at 16 fps (the template's CreateVideo, and its duration maths `floor(seconds * 16 + 1)`); trained on 81 frames (5 s), so a longer shot is a warning, and past 161 frames (10 s) it must be split. Width and height are multiples of 16 (WanImageToVideo's step); sizes that aren't legal are snapped down, then shrunk under 720p (1280 on the long side, 921600 pixels).

recipe._note: Image to video: shot:<id>:first is REQUIRED (it is the picture Wan animates; WanImageToVideo's start_image). A shot without it is blocked, like a missing ref, and can't be rendered anyway: make one with continuity (h3.py keyframe, or the editor), import one, or retarget the shot to wan22_ti2v. shot:<id>:last is optional; with it the graph uses WanFirstLastFrameToVideo instead. No identity references: subjects are written in words from the series config's `design`. No sound: every policy renders silent and says so.

policy_fallback.why: Wan 2.2 makes no sound (lay the soundtrack in at the edit)

keyframe_required.first: Wan 14B I2V needs a first frame: use continuity or import one, or retarget to wan22_ti2v

size_hints.keyframe: the render size (any size works: it is scaled and centre-cropped to the frame)

binding._note: An API graph built from ComfyUI's Wan 2.2 14B image-to-video template as the user saved it (video_wan2_2_14B_i2v.json): its subgraph flattened and its 4-step LoRA switches resolved to the LoRA branch, so no switch or primitive is left and every node the binding names has a title. Two stages: the high noise model (+ its lightx2v LoRA, shift 5) samples steps [0, split) with noise, the low noise model (+ its LoRA) finishes [split, end) (`stages`; patch_graph sets split = the preset's `split` fraction of the steps). `model` / `model_low` are the two UNETLoaders; `loras` is one chain per stage: a LoRA goes to the stage its `stage` names, else by its name (*high_noise* / *low_noise*), else to both. H3SaveShot takes the place of CreateVideo/SaveVideo (no audio input: the mp4 is mute) at the job's fps.

presets._note: The 14B fp8 pair with lightx2v's 4-step LoRA pair (strength 1), 4 steps split 2/2, cfg 1, euler / simple, shift 5: the template's 4-step branch. Final 832x480 (Wan's 480p; the template itself says 640x640), proxy 640x352. Another target's series config block lends no size: Wan was trained at 480p/720p. The negative prompt is Wan's standard one from ComfyUI's Wan templates (it is ignored at cfg 1, used when a profile drops the LoRAs for cfg > 1).
